author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Microsoft just unveiled a completely redesigned Copilot. I visited Microsoft for an early look at the new experience and sat down with the team behind it.

In this video, we explore the new Copilot Home, Autopilot, Code, and the integration of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint directly into Copilot. You'll see how Microsoft is bringing chat, AI agents, app building, and Office together into a single experience.

We’ll also look at how Autopilot can handle recurring work in the background, how anyone can build interactive tools with Code, and why Microsoft believes Copilot can stand out from other AI assistants.

Host: Kevin Stratvert
